nodes.summary: Let a finite group $G$ act on a commutative algebra $S$ over a commutative ring $R$ by $R$-algebra automorphisms such that every element of $S$ fixed by $G$ is the image of an element of $R$. Let $Q$ and $Q'$ be primes of $S$ with $S/Q$ and $S/Q'$ finite at which $S$ is unramified over $R$. If $Q$ and $Q'$ have the same preimage in $R$, then the Frobenius conjugacy classes at $Q$ and $Q'$ are equal.

nodes.summary: Let a finite group $G$ act on a commutative algebra $S$ over a commutative ring $R$ by $R$-algebra automorphisms such that every element of $S$ fixed by $G$ is the image of an element of $R$. For every prime $Q$ of $S$ with $S/Q$ finite at which $S$ is unramified over $R$, the chosen arithmetic Frobenius element $\mathrm{Frob}_Q$ at $Q$ belongs to the Frobenius conjugacy class at $Q$.
